groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.791% and the 10Y at 5.242%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 4 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +0.23% over five sessions and +1.86% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +2.25% at about $107.08, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-11/100, 61% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.242%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -0.76% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -11/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -5 → now -11; open -10 → now -11 (deteriorated 1 points).

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are a headwind: Live · SOX -2.60% | Nasdaq -0.47% | SOX vs Nasdaq -2.13 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -2.11 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq -1.55 pp. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.791% (+3.5 bp vs prev close). Mega-caps are supportive: Live · 7-stock basket +0.40% | 4/7 positive | QQQ -0.76% | relative +1.16 pp.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors negative, mega-caps positive, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, a material volatility expansion.
Semiconductor catalyst context: LRCX vs MU: Contrasting Lam Research and Micron Technology Across the AI Semiconductor Cycle. Strong negative sector read-through; Persisting 4 sessions later.
